initial_windows_failures.classification: CLI formatter ignore rules skipped explicit manifests under Temp paths; index stdout underwent platform newline translation.

Archive path ownership rejected the generated temporary archive. A canonical-parent alias reproduces that branch locally; the native log does not show both compared paths, so the exact Windows alias remains unconfirmed. Separately, the registry CLI leaked its text protocol into subsequent JSON runner controls.

portability_corrections: Explicit generated manifests use an owned empty ignore file and with-node-modules to match the original Prettier API. Invalid formatter configuration still fails before publication.
The newly owned npm temporary root is canonicalized once. The archive child must still be a physical owned file.
The registry CLI restores its caller output protocol on success and failure.

retained_review_context: The generic web-framework serializer suggestion does not apply to a command-line JSON bridge; json.dumps remains the serializer.
The retained formatter concern is resolved by actual Temp/node_modules reproductions: the formatter returned exit zero with unformatted input and skipped invalid configuration.
The original small-JSON API probe incorrectly expected multiline formatting. Its actual single-line formatted output and corrected verdict are retained in session evidence.

publication_recovery.normal_failure: Roll back attempted replacements and retain original file modes.
publication_recovery.rollback_failure_or_interruption: Retain before/after files and recovery.json. Later migration and check commands refuse pending recovery.
publication_recovery.unblock: Inspect recovery.json and its recorded owned paths and hashes. Restore each remaining backup by replacement. Verify a missing backup against before_sha256; remove a published path only when the journal says no original file existed. Remove the recovery directory only after the original batch has been restored, then retry the whole migration.
publication_recovery.limits: Filesystem operations cannot guarantee rollback when the operating system refuses restoration. A hard process termination can leave recovery work. No automatic deletion of pending recovery state is permitted.

performance_scope: Existing paired timing records describe their captured source hashes before these correctness and portability fixes. No new timing or native Windows performance claim is made for the corrected implementation.
native_windows_verification: Pending the next CI run for the submitted revision; local reproductions do not substitute for it.
raw_evidence: Original and corrected captures, failing/passing logs and full masked CI job logs remain in ignored session evidence.
